prompt:
A battle background for a side-on JRPG battle scene (the party will stand on the right, monsters on the left; no characters are drawn), in rich high-resolution 2D pixel art. The world is in an endless night: the sun has vanished and people live by lamplight. Setting: the open top of an old star-reading tower. Back (top 42%): an overwhelming starry sky with the milky way and falling stars, brass astronomical rings and a great telescope silhouette, city walls far below. Ground (lower 58%): a round stone platform floor with an inlaid star map, brass rails at the sides. Light: starlight, cool blue with gold glints. The ground plane recedes from the bottom edge up to the horizon line at a low 3/4 angle; the middle of the ground (from 55% to 90% of the height, centre and right) is open, fairly flat and uncluttered: space for the battle. Details (rocks, plants, debris) sit at the sides and far away. 
No lantern, no fire in the middle, no people, no monsters, no text, no UI.
Pixel art: every art pixel is 4x4 image pixels (the image is 960 x 540 art pixels), crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, hue-shifted colour ramps (shadows toward violet, lights toward warm yellow), clusters with clear shapes, not a painting.
revised_prompt: Generate a wide 16:9 background ONLY for a side-on JRPG battle scene, rich high-resolution 2D PIXEL ART. Composition: party standing area on RIGHT and monsters area on LEFT, but draw NO characters or creatures. Endless-night fantasy world, the sun has vanished and distant people live by lamplight. Setting: open rooftop of an ancient star-reading observatory tower. Upper 42% dominated by overwhelming deep indigo starry sky, luminous clustered Milky Way and a few falling stars; brass astronomical armillary rings and silhouette of a massive telescope confined to distant background/edges, city walls tiny and far below. Lower 58% round ancient stone platform floor, inlaid subtle brass star chart map; brass railings at extreme left and right perimeter. Floor recedes from bottom edge to horizon at low three-quarter angle. Crucial battle space: centre and right of ground from 55% to 90% of image height OPEN, reasonably flat, uncluttered and readable, star-chart inlay low contrast. Any decorative rubble, tiny weeds and loose objects only at extreme sides or far background. Cool cobalt starlight, gold brass glints; hue-shifted color ramps with violet shadows and warm yellow highlights. STRONG pixel-art construction: crisp discrete square pixels, no antialiasing, no painterly texture, purposeful clusters of pixels and clearly defined shapes, pixelated stars. Target 960x540 logical art pixels, each art pixel displayed as a sharply edged 4x4 block if rendered at 3840x2160. No lantern, no fire in middle, no people, no monsters, no text, no interface/UI.
